column4: gold-white impact star, still bright on the target
a sheen sweeps it, glints, no white-out
a gout of violet acid bursts over it
pale wing cuts with white edge
orange wind spirals up with flames, no ring
hands small at this scale, flash
air bends at the head, motes circle in, no circle
water shroud reads as white puffs
water shroud reads as white puffs
green sphere from a soft gather, no ring
curtains of light, still mostly cyan
big ice chunks fall in steam
gold impact, dust and cracks instead of a ring
glints gather; the guard itself comes from the protocol
beats and a blaze, no ring
a tan coil winds and tightens
fireball bursts into a five-armed blaze
impact then fire, kick not drawn
fire reads as round blobs, no heat haze
body still whitens before the flames
cracks and dust skirts, no ring
still a white-out on the target
thick cyan beam with a white core
snow swirls down over the court
a lit orb weaves over and circles
wind lines and leaves sweep across
small violet flames on the user
lightning in every direction; user still whitens
blue flames climb, still white body
thick green roots lash up out of the floor
ground glows and fire bursts up
cracks and dust over the whole court, no ring
current arcs fly and close round it
magenta wash, glow wrings it, fewer rings
lightning crawls over the floor, glints
a fireball, but it whites out the stage
tornado over the target, dark sky
orange sphere from a soft gather
ice closes round it, no ring
green glow and motes stream home, leaves
a white block over the target
thick vines lash up round its feet
soft gather, glints (room comes from the field)
black-violet mist rolls over the court
notes and gold light pulse, no rings
a star falls, green light wells up
thick beam, too white at its core
pink waves from the eyes, air bending
dark burst, the item flies off lit
seeds still small at the throw
wall of water crosses the court
lightning on every side, green drain
a wall of lit panels rises
sleepy sway, big Zs, green light
boulders fall and hem it in
a puff of smoke and glints
shell chips burst off, fire flare
cream chips spray over the foe's side
cream stones jut up in dust
steel blades turn and cross overhead in a flash
target whitens under a red mark
dark sky, bolt from the cloud, cracks
arcs of force with bending air
fire orbs circle and float across
a lit bubble drifts over and pops
a red rim and a blaze of will, no white-out
a court-filling fireball of orange lobes and smoke
a soft spotlight on it, motes fall
a dust cloud of blows and stars
green light and motes rise, body keeps its colour
a spinning triangle of fire, ice and lightning
a blue jet with a white core, splash
orange-white beam on a dark stage
moonlight falls, body keeps its colour
flames and streaks rise, body keeps its colour
water ribbons swirl round the charging body, spray
water ribbons swirl round it, tail arc
water ribbons swirl round it, splash
waves of darkness edged violet roll out, the air bending
licking flames carried across on hot air
round 3: SV hex-pane ball (pale sky blue, deep rim), lab plays the guard line, no rim on body
round 3: three water ribbons wind round it as arcs, bubbles, aura rim softened
